not_covered_in_ci: full texts and gap-search abstracts: run `python3 scripts/research/leak_check.py --require-cache` locally before committing
protected: register abstracts whose licence does not allow redistribution (CC BY-NC, BY-NC-ND, publisher, TDM-only, none) and the out-of-register abstracts cited in doc 10
purpose: lets CI check committed agent-written files for verbatim runs from protected abstracts without the local cache; hashes only, no text
rule: every 8-token run (case-folded \w+ tokens, URLs/DOIs/PMCIDs removed) of each protected abstract with at least 5 word tokens, minus exempt runs (titles, journal names, author lists, locator headings, runs that also occur in a CC BY / BY-SA / CC0 register text); sha256('sela-leak-v1|' + run) truncated to 12 hex characters
